rows.title: Germinal Commodity details has the live-animals frame, an optional number of packages for semen, embryo and ova lines, one optional temperature question, and goes straight on after a valid save
rows.detail: The germinal products set's copy of Commodity details keeps the same back link, caption, heading, Selected commodities table and commodity groups as the live-animals page, with one table row per germinal commodity listing all its chosen species and section breaks between the species sections of a group. A species whose commodity the data fields page's package-count list names (its semen, embryo and ova lines) also asks an optional number of packages after the quantity. One optional temperature question for the whole consignment follows all the commodity groups. The total gross weight stays in each species block, so a valid Save and continue goes straight on to the next page of the germinal journey, with no page of its own for the consignment's weight.
acceptanceCriteria: Germinal Commodity details has the same back link, caption, heading, Selected commodities table and commodity groups as the live-animals page. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p3-011, -p3-020; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p2-022, -p2-023; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-014)

A germinal commodity has one Selected commodities row listing all its chosen species, such as '05111000 | Cattle, Semen | Domestic cattle (Bos taurus)', and its group is headed '<commodity name> (<commodity code>)', such as 'Cattle, Semen (05111000)'. (trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p4-035, -p4-046; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p2-022; prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p3-011)
Inside a germinal commodity group with two chosen species, the two species sections are separated by a section break. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p3-020)

A germinal species whose commodity is a semen, embryo or ova line on the data fields page's package-count list asks 'Number of packages' after 'Quantity (unit/pieces)', labelled exactly so, with no hint. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p3-088; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p4-037; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p2-025; ruling:ian-2026-11-11 ruling-ian-2026-11-11-p1-008; ruling:sam-2026-11-27 ruling-sam-2026-11-27-p1-004; c-324, c-459)

A germinal 'Number of packages' left blank saves with no error; a value that is not a whole number of 1 or more, such as 'x' or 0, shows 'Number of packages must be a whole number greater than 0' in the error summary and above that species' field, the summary link moving focus to that field. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p3-089; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p4-042; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p2-032)

Germinal Commodity details asks one 'Temperature' question for the consignment, after all the commodity groups and behind a section break: radios with the legend 'Temperature' at label size, the hint 'How the products will be stored.' and the options 'Ambient', 'Chilled' and 'Frozen' in that order. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p3-038, -p3-040, -p3-092; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p4-039, -p4-047; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p2-027, -p2-028, -p2-029; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-021)

Saving germinal Commodity details with every quantity valid and the 'Temperature' question unanswered shows no error and the page moves on. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-021; c-232, c-462)

A valid Save and continue on germinal Commodity details, reached in the journey, goes straight to the page the germinal journey puts after Commodity details; the total gross weight is asked only in each species block on Commodity details, and the journey has no page asking a total gross weight for the whole consignment. (ruling:sam-2026-11-27 ruling-sam-2026-11-27-p1-004; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-022; c-231, c-461, c-486)
notes: existingRow inc-017: req-2596, req-2598 and req-2599 already sit in it. req-2601 is new and joins it: it is the same germinal Commodity details page, its Save and continue and the per-species weight inc-017 already asks, so building it apart would repeat the page's set-up, review and ladder. The combiner keeps inc-017's other areas' criteria (quantity, weight, storage, publishing) beside these and drops any it already states once.

c-461 and c-486 (precedence, 27 November ruling): the total gross weight stays per species and no consignment-level weight page or hub row is built, so the prototype's hop to that page is set aside and not restated. c-462 and c-232: the temperature is optional.

The page the germinal journey puts after Commodity details is Identification details where a chosen species needs identifiers once the germinal identification row (inc-052) lands; inc-052 depends on this row, so the Save and continue criterion names the journey's next page rather than Identification details, to stay observable when this row lands.
Repos here are frontend and tests only, for this area's requirements; inc-017's backend storage and publishing criteria come from the notification-record and germinal-products areas' drafts.

None of this area's split-off requirements (req-105, req-108, req-110, req-112, req-2132, req-2586, req-2587, req-2588, req-2589, req-2595) is drafted; they are held by their split-off themes' pointers.

rows.title: The germinal overview's Commodity details task is complete once every chosen species has a valid quantity and every optional answer entered is valid
rows.detail: On a germinal products notification the overview's Commodity details task follows the count the page makes mandatory, the quantity in units or pieces, so a trader sees Complete once every chosen species has one and nothing optional they entered is wrong. Optional answers left blank, the temperature included, never hold the task back.
acceptanceCriteria: On a germinal products notification, the overview's Commodity details task shows the Complete tag when every chosen species has a whole number quantity of 1 or more within its limit, with number of packages, total gross weight and temperature left blank. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p3-024, -p3-099; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-021, -p1-022; ruling:sam-2026-11-27 ruling-sam-2026-11-27-p1-004; c-232, c-234, c-462)

On a germinal products notification, the overview's Commodity details task shows the Complete tag when every chosen species has a valid quantity, a number of packages of 1 or more, a total gross weight greater than 0 and a temperature chosen. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p3-099; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-022, -p1-057; ruling:sam-2026-11-27 ruling-sam-2026-11-27-p1-004; c-234)

On a germinal products notification, the overview's Commodity details task shows the 'To do' tag while any chosen species has no quantity, or has a number of packages or a total gross weight entered that is not valid, such as 0. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p3-099; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-057; c-232, c-234, c-279)
On a germinal products notification with no species chosen, the overview's Commodity details task shows the 'To do' tag. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p3-054)
notes: existingRow inc-099: req-1763 already sits in the germinal overview row, whose page the rule is observed on; the combiner keeps these four criteria beside the notification-hub area's draft of the same row.

c-462 and c-232 (precedence): temperature, number of packages and total gross weight are optional, so the prototype's chosen-temperature condition is not built; an entered optional value that is not valid still holds the task back. c-234 makes the quantity the one mandatory count; its upper limit is the germinal quantity check's (inc-177), so the criterion says 'within its limit' rather than restating the figure.
The live-animals half of the rule (req-126) is already met and gets no row.
